scoring_justification: Headline output consists of two fitted constants; the checker cannot re-run the full mean-field simulation and fitting, but can compare the submitted constants to the paper's reported hidden gold with appropriate tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference values for the two interaction constants
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper abstract and text: 'The energy difference ... 3.0×10^{-3} eV per atom. The force ... 0.04 eV/u0'
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported numerical values; inline in grading_spec_json as part of step configuration.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own quantitative results, not invented.

outputs.description: This artifact contains the two interaction constants determined from the model fit: the energy difference between distortions along the ⟨11⟩ and ⟨10⟩ directions, and the force exerted on a surface W atom by an adsorbed H atom in an adjacent bridge site.

output_contract.notes: The experimental phase diagram data used for fitting is bundled as exp_phase_diagram.csv. The model implementation and fitting code are not predefined; the agent must construct them from the method description.

steps.description: Check both interaction constants against paper references with tolerances.
